functions.name: ABS

functions.name: LEFT
functions.description: Extracts the left-most count characters.

functions.name: LEN
functions.description: Number of characters in string.

functions.name: LENGTH

functions.description: Executes the aggregate function function_name on the elements of list.

functions.name: LIST_CONTAINS

functions.name: LIST_INTERSECT

functions.description: Returns the index of the element if the list contains the element. If the element is not found, it returns NULL.
